title: Resource Groups vs Management Groups
description: Organize Azure resources using resource groups and management groups effectively.

data.text: Your organization has 200 Azure resources across 10 subscriptions. You need to organize them for billing, access control, and lifecycle management. Should you use resource groups, management groups, or both?
Use **Management Groups** for subscription-level organization and policy enforcement. Use **Resource Groups** for grouping related resources that share the same lifecycle.

data.title: Azure CLI - Create Management Group Hierarchy
data.code:
# Create management group
az account management-group create --name 'Production' --display-name 'Production Resources'

# Create child management group
az account management-group create --name 'Production-EastUS' --parent-id '/providers/Microsoft.Management/managementGroups/Production'

# Move subscription to management group
az account management-group subscription add --name 'Production' --subscription 'my-subscription-id'

data.title: ARM Template - Resource Group with Tags

data.text: **Management Groups** provide hierarchical governance across subscriptions. **Resource Groups** enable atomic deployment, RBAC, and lifecycle management for related resources. Together they provide complete organizational control.
